problem_or_opportunity.summary: TK's first modeling TikTok has an agreed nine-frame arc but no cut timing, no render pipeline, and no frames available to an agent that only has repository access.
problem_or_opportunity.detail: The full-resolution masters are a 4.4GB archive on TK's workstation and are deliberately not committed. Codex can reach the repository but not the archive, so the work stalled on resources rather than on judgement. A third batch of transfers completed the archive on 2026-09-08, which also opened up four photographic registers the original nine frames did not cover.

originating_signal.detail: TK asked for the repository to carry clear instructions and resources so Codex can update the modeling page and finish the TikTok video.

priority.rationale: Content work with no external deadline. Blocked nothing else, but the archive verification that gated it is now complete.

evidence.detail: Decode pass over all 292 archived files: 291 healthy, 1 corrupt (IMG_6089-edited.jpg, truncated to 4194304 bytes).

assets/campaigns/barelysain/IMG_6881-edited.jpg is a corrupt JPEG: 4005 extraneous bytes and a premature end of data segment. Used as campaign frame 7 on the modeling page. A clean master exists in the archive.
tools/build-tiktok.sh renders 1080x1920 h264 at 30fps, duration 10.300s, from the committed derivatives. Verified on Omarchy 2026-09-08.

desired_outcome.summary: A rendered 9:16 BarelySain TikTok cut TK can review, and a modeling page with its corrupt asset resolved.
artifacts: A stated concern or confirmation on the frame 5 crop
Resolution path for the corrupt IMG_6881-edited.jpg web asset

constraints.no_browser_verification: The Codex browser adapter in tk-ap/agent-os (adapters/codex/browser.py) fails closed and returns BLOCKED. Visual confirmation of the live page must come from TK or another authorized surface.
constraints.no_baked_text: On-screen text and caption are added natively in TikTok and must never be burned into the render.
constraints.render_silent: No audio track. Audio is chosen in TikTok and overrides all frame durations.
constraints.masters_not_in_repo: Full-resolution masters stay at ~/ASHWOOD/Modeling/BarelySain/Originals and in the ~/ASHWOOD/tiktok Drive folder. Do not commit them; the archive is 4.4GB against a 45MB repository.
constraints.selection_not_approved: The twelve-frame arc, the per-frame durations and the IMG_5539 to IMG_5538 swap are proposals. Rendering them is not approval of them.
constraints.crop_is_a_judgement: Centre-crop is the script default, not a decision. Frame 5 (IMG_5538) is known to be weakened by it.

human_oversight.gate_rationale: Frame selection, ordering and crop are materially aesthetic. Per policies/HANDOFF_POLICY.md an agent may surface evidence and concerns but must not manufacture visual approval.
decisions_reserved_to_human: Per-frame crop position within the 9:16 window
Whether to ship the nine-frame or twelve-frame arc

acceptance_criteria: tools/build-tiktok.sh completes without error and reports a total matching the sum of frames[].seconds in docs/tiktok-v3-frames.json
The rendered file is 1080x1920, 30fps, 9:16, with no audio stream
No text is burned into any frame of the render
Every frames[].file entry in the manifest resolves to a file in assets/tiktok/source/
Every image referenced by portfolio/index.html exists and decodes without a corruption warning, or the exceptions are reported with the failing identify output
The frame 5 crop is either confirmed acceptable with evidence or raised as a specific concern, not silently accepted
No full-resolution master is added to the repository
